text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Waaaay☆ Vibes are through the roooof!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, there's nobody here! Didn't we 
talk about chilling at the beach!?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, it's not today?! Big fail, big 
sad!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to hang out with her friends, 
Daitaku Helios's hype completely deflated.
